verdict.rationale: Composio's white-labeling docs say you can swap in your own logo and app name, set a theme in the dashboard, and restyle the whole auth page to match your product, so the branding half is documented. The evidence never states that you can supply your own OAuth client ID and secret: the 'four places where Composio branding shows up' line and the `auth_config` parameter only hint at it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bring-your-own OAuth app credentials, independent or hands-on confirmation that white-labeled flows work end to end.
